title: Build the achievement grid and blocking badge detail modal
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement Achievements UI from the approved48-entry catalog/progress port, not new unlock logic. Unlocked badges use approved original full-colour art; locked public badges are grayscale, locked secret ones reveal only Unknown afterimage. Tap opens a blocking glass detail modal with artwork/name/description/allowed progress/date. Unlocked art palette can drive a slow subtle glow; Reduce Motion makes it static. Locked/secret states must not leak undisclosed names, conditions, dates or roles through DOM/alt/asset filenames. Preserve common bottom navigation and banner reserve.
acceptance: The48-catalog grid handles empty/new, mixed locked/unlocked and complete progress states without inventing awards.
Secret locked tiles/details expose only the allowed unknown label and no hidden achievement metadata or role.
Tap/keyboard detail is a genuine blocking modal, unlocked art remains full colour, locked art grayscale and motion setting respected.
UI consumes approved asset keys/progress/date and never evaluates hidden match state or unlocks competitive achievements itself.
designSections: ACHIEVEMENTS-SPEC-v0: Presentación UI, Starter catalogue; SCREEN-FLOW: Support screens
